title: Blue Angels Sneak Pass Through Miami
description: 190524-N-UK306-1006 MIAMI (May 24, 2019) Lt. Cmdr. Andre Webb, opposing solo pilot assigned to The U.S. Navy Flight Demonstration Squadron, the Blue Angels, performs the sneak pass during the 2019 Air and Sea Show in Miami. The Blue Angels are scheduled to conduct 61 flight demonstrations at 32 locations across the country to showcase the pride and professionalism of the U.S. Navy and Marine Corps to the American and Canadian public in 2019. (U.S. Navy photo by Mass Communication Specialist 2nd Class Timothy Schumaker/Released)
